description: Check a finished video for named, mechanical issues, ONLY when the user asks (never after every render, and it never re-renders): loudness vs a target (default -14 LUFS) and true peak, black and frozen stretches, captions or text outside the platform-safe band, text running off the frame. Optional assertions about named elements: appearsBy {element, bySec}, before {a, b}, staysInFrame {element}, keepsMoving {maxStaticSec}. Each issue comes with a Fix line. The loudness, black and frozen checks are free; the on-screen text and element read is a small paid frame read (frames:false skips it).

assertions.description: what must hold, checked on sampled frames

element.description: an element named in words, e.g. "the logo"

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

frames.description: false skips the paid text and element read

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

loudnessTarget.description: integrated loudness target in LUFS, default -14

url.description: the video: a /generated/ path, a public URL or a post link

name: check_video
title: Check a video
